day_shape: 83 items: tanker Al-Ghaiya attacked in Strait of Hormuz with Oman towing it to shore, IRIB/IRGC claim third US MQ-1 drone downed, Rubio-Oman call, Israel-Saudi CENTCOM-brokered talks reported, Araghchi to visit China Wednesday, heavy '200 nights' regime messaging.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker and drone incidents
threads.summary: A Panama-flagged supertanker Al-Ghaiya was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz and is being towed to shore by Oman, while IRIB and IRGC-linked Defa Press claimed a third US MQ-1 drone was downed. Turkey called on the US and Iran to halt reciprocal Gulf attacks, and Iran International reported Hormuz shipping traffic fell sharply.

threads.label: US and regional diplomacy on Iran
threads.summary: Secretary Rubio called Omani FM al-Busaidi, condemning Iranian attacks on commercial ships; US, Israeli and Arab commanders convened in Germany last week to discuss the Iran conflict, and Israel-Saudi talks on Houthi defence were mediated by CENTCOM. Iran's FM Araghchi will visit China on Wednesday, following Xi's BRICS peace call.

threads.label: Iran nuclear file and IAEA dispute
threads.summary: Israel's Atomic Energy Commission Director-General Moshe Edri told the IAEA's 70th general conference that Iran holds over nine tons of nuclear material outside safeguards. Iran's Atomic Energy Organization deputy questioned the basis of the IAEA Director General's interviews and inspection findings.

threads.label: Yemen, Houthis and Red Sea
threads.summary: The UN Security Council convened on Yemen following Houthi seizure of Mokha, Mayyun and the Hanish islands, with over 100,000 internally displaced per UNHCR. IRIB cited Yemen's armed forces claiming 52 Saudi airstrikes in 24 hours, and Defa Press posted images of strikes on Saudi-backed forces in Jouf.

threads.label: IDF strikes in Gaza and Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF announced killing Hamas Jabaliya Battalion commander Ahmad al-Batash, PIJ rocket-cell commander Mohsen Abu Hadaf in Khan Younis, and Hamas company commander Rafat Abu Zamar, and located a Hezbollah rocket launcher with 32 rockets and a tunnel shaft in Mount Dov. Additional Hezbollah munitions were reported found in southern Lebanon's buffer zone.

threads.label: Regime '200 nights' messaging and war narrative
threads.summary: IRIB, Defa Press and Khamenei's office marked nearly 200 nights of public gatherings, with messages from Mokhber, IRGC Navy commander Azamati, Judiciary chief Mohseni Azhei and FM Araghchi claiming hundreds of US bases destroyed. Defa Press cited a purported Pentagon Inspector General report on US losses.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression and Western measures
threads.summary: Britain, the US and the Netherlands issued a joint cybersecurity advisory on Iranian state-linked spyware targeting dissidents, and the European Parliament named Iran among states behind hybrid attacks on Europe. US prosecutors are seeking forfeiture of $61 million in crypto tied to sanctioned Iranian oil sales, while Iran International reported Baha'i arrests in Shiraz, Evin Prison abuses and a 'Last Breath' execution campaign.
